title: Two days in Thornwick

lodging.name: Kestrel Steps Inn
lodging.note: Breakfast included; the inn sits at the foot of the hill steps.

intro: An invented hill town for testing: everything is a short walk, some of it uphill on steps and footpaths, and Google returns no public-transport route at all.

practical.title: Getting around
practical.text: Walk: the town is small but steep. Taxis wait at the inn for the hill road.
items: The lookout path is steps most of the way.
